items.title: Bitcoin reclaims $80,000, Solana and Hyperliquid rally as crypto markets shrug off Clarity setback
items.whyYouShouldCare: Bitcoin's surge to $80,000 boosts overall market sentiment, positively impacting Solana's visibility and potential liquidity in the crypto ecosystem.

items.title: Solana speeds up blocks by 17%, but transaction capacity stays the same
items.whyYouShouldCare: While Solana's block speed improvement enhances performance, the unchanged transaction capacity may limit its scalability and competitiveness against other networks.

items.title: Coinbase Files to List Single-Stock Perps on Apple, Tesla and Nvidia
items.whyYouShouldCare: Coinbase's move to list single-stock perpetuals could attract more institutional interest, indirectly benefiting Solana by increasing overall market engagement.
